scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 35 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-sacri-monti-of-piedmont-and-lomba.story: A 368 km round trip from Ossuccio - roughly 6 h 21 in the saddle. On the way it passes Chateau de Sasso Corbaro, Valli di Lodano, Sacro Monte Calvario and Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch. The highest point is about 2,350 m. It crosses from Italy into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
